before: In an ordered room, a change that names its whole story (a row or column deletion, a picked control value, a move) did not draw the notes part again, so every editor kept a note whose reference the change hid, while the room's list and the saved file left it out.
after: The publish after such a change also draws the notes part of each note reference the change reaches, so every editor shows the list's notes.
reason: Change messages, the change log and its kinds keep their meaning, and the Yjs document format does not change. Only which parts a client draws again into its own editor after a change changes; the room's list and its saved file are the same as before.
